title: B1G Countdown to Kickoff
description: Countdown to Kickoff takes you on the field leading up to game time with previews of the day's biggest games, plus the latest news from reporters across the country.

title: College Football
description:
UCLA at Maryland
Maryland hosts Big Ten opponent UCLA at SECU Stadium in Week 4 college football game. Maryland looks to reset following a 35-26 setback against Virginia Tech, while UCLA builds on a 52-38 offensive outburst against Purdue in search of a road win.

title: B1G  Football Game Break
description: Our analysts check in on the action all across the B1G as football Saturday continues.

title: College Football
description:
Nebraska at Michigan State
The Michigan State Spartans host the Nebraska Cornhuskers. Nebraska enters at 3-0 following a 34-7 win over North Dakota led by Anthony Colandrea's 195 passing yards, while Michigan State is 2-1 after a 27-10 loss to No. 3 Notre Dame.
